content.p: one problem is if there's no hash then none of the tabs are visible. if you care about that you can counter it by including a line of javascript that adds a default hash if none is present

another problem is that setting the hash auto-scrolls to the element with that id, which makes it unideal for scrolling pages (like this one). this issue isn't really fixable without a heavier dose of javascript but you can reset the scroll to the top of the page every time you set the hash. as if you'd navigated to a new page
